narrative.coaching_note: El cambio más importante es hacer higiene de manos con alcohol o con agua y jabón después de tocar el entorno de resident A y antes de tocar phone o a resident A. Usted tocó bed rail A desde 1.6 segundos y esa contaminación pasó a su bare hand. Después tocó call button a los 7.6 segundos y luego phone a los 12.4 segundos, así que la contaminación llegó a phone. Después tocó a resident A a los 21.4 segundos sin higiene antes, y la contaminación llegó a resident A. Faltaron dos momentos de higiene: después del entorno y antes de tocar al residente. Si hubiera hecho higiene a los 11 segundos, usted habría mantenido limpios bare hand, gloved hand, phone y resident A.
narrative.audit_summary: Staged clip with C. auris source bed rail A. Bare hand contacted bed rail A at 1.6 s, then call button at 7.6 s, phone at 12.4 s, and resident A at 21.4 s, with transfer at each step and resident A exposure at 21.4 s. Hand hygiene compliance 0/2 opportunities: Moment 1 0/1, Moment 5 0/1. Missed Moment 5 at 11 s after patient-zone contact and missed Moment 1 at 21.4 s before resident contact. No hand hygiene events performed; no glove use issues noted. Alcohol rub and soap and water are effective against C. auris per record. End contamination included bare hand, gloved hand, bed rail A, call button, phone, and resident A. Disinfect bed rail A, call button, phone, and resident A's bedside zone (linen and surfaces) with an EPA List P registered disinfectant; routine quaternary ammonium products are not reliable.
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene for Moment 5 at 11 seconds.
